title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a freestanding toilet tissue stand that adds convenient roll storage without wall mounting in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. Crafted from solid brass and designed with a heavy base and felt pad, it’s ideal when wall space is at a premium.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stable base: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs

  • Type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions: 6-Inch W x 5.5-Inch L x 26-Inch H
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included: Toilet tissue stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
